description: This file defines a base class 'Modal' for handling Ant Design modal components in Playwright tests. It provides methods for interacting with modal elements, such as waiting for visibility, clicking footer buttons, and checking if the modal is hidden.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: A base class for interacting with Ant Design modal dialogs in Playwright tests, providing methods to wait for visibility, interact with footer buttons, and handle modal state.

methods.name: element
methods.description: Returns the Locator for the modal element.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: Returns the Locator for the modal footer containing action buttons.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the Locator for the modal body containing content.

methods.name: getFooterButton
methods.description: Private helper method to get a footer button by its text content.

methods.name: clickFooterButton
methods.description: Clicks a footer button identified by its text content, with optional click parameters.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits for the modal to become visible.

methods.name: waitForReady
methods.description: Waits for the modal to be fully ready for interaction, including React rendering.

methods.name: waitForHidden
methods.description: Waits for the modal to be hidden.
